articles.summary: The Railway Recruitment Board has announced the RRB NTPC Undergraduate CBT 1 result 2026, allowing candidates to check their qualification status and cut-off details. Those shortlisted will advance to CBT 2, scheduled for September 17, 2026.

articles.title: Education Minister Pralhad Joshi reviews CBSE functioning, stresses efficiency and transparency
articles.summary: The Education Minister Pralhad Joshi reviewed the functioning of CBSE with senior education officials, focusing on academic, examination and administrative systems. The meeting stressed the need for greater efficiency, transparency and stronger support for students and teachers.

articles.title: Gurugram schools to switch to online classes on August 25 amid heavy rain, waterlogging concerns
articles.summary: Gurugram schools will shift to online classes on August 25 as heavy rainfall raises concerns over waterlogging and traffic disruption across the district. Authorities have advised schools and institutions to minimise physical movement, while offices have been asked to facilitate work from home.

articles.title: Who is Kaziah Liz Mejo? Meet the 19-year-old law student from Kerala who won Miss Universe India 2026
articles.summary: Kaziah Liz Mejo, a 19-year-old law student and model from Kerala, has won the Miss Universe India 2026 crown in Jaipur. The Mavelikkara native, who grew up in Abu Dhabi, has a strong background in academics, classical dance, music and acting.

articles.title: ‘Awarapan 2’ box office collection day 11: Emraan Hashmi starrer passes second Monday test
articles.summary: Awarapan 2 stands out as a blockbuster hit in Bollywood for 2026, inching closer to the Rs 150 crore milestone within India. In just ten days, it has outperformed the profit margins of Murder.

articles.title: Russ Abbot opens up on fame, love and more
articles.summary: In a heartfelt discussion, veteran entertainer Russ Abbot shared insights from his storied life and career, including his transition from school to the music scene. He celebrated his long-lasting marriage to Trish, spanning six decades, and shared how their humble origins influenced their approach to fame.

articles.title: 'The Gentlemen' renewed for Season 3 as S2 trailer releases- WATCH
articles.summary: Netflix confirmed the crime drama The Gentlemen has been renewed for a third season. The trailer for the second season also dropped online ahead of its September premiere.

articles.title: 'Batwara 1947' box office collection day 11
articles.summary: The cinematic battle of 1947 continues to disappoint at the box office, lying stagnant after its second Monday. In stark contrast, the much-anticipated Awarapan 2 is soaring past all expectations, raking in over one hundred thirty-six crore net in India.
